final_period_prior_exposure: all periods repeatedly viewed; no pristine holdout

cost_and_fill_model.swap: not included; broker rollover clock unverified

position_sizing_and_currency.phase_restart: standalone diagnostics only; continuous_diagnostic after final independent replay never resets 2020-2025

cross_symbol_rule: all three predetermined symbols; pooled equal-risk trades are descriptive, not portfolio returns
phase_rule: training and validation gates; failure stops; final_confirmation descriptive without gate selection; same candidate continuous_diagnostic after final independent replay complete irrespective of final P/L
code_identifier: scripts/research_fxspace_m5_20261011.py plus inherited frozen execution/features/metrics; source/tests/spec/dependencies SHA before results
selection_rule: At most one of four main candidates by normal PF, mean netR, trades descending, lexical arm then RR ascending; no fallback
phase_boundary: Fresh scenarios/used supports/positions at phase start; indicators warmup allowed; no pre-phase signals; phase account resets are standalone diagnostics, never within phase

frequency_baseline.rule: candidate phase trades / phase months strictly greater than frozen prior-training count / 36; old later phases not replayed

final_confirmation_policy: descriptive only after training and validation gates pass; never automatic adoption
